privacy: Fixed event categories and structural counts only; no selectors, text, IDs, routes, network payloads or storage contents.

protocols.question: Which visible selection and navigation state changes when a fictional conversation becomes active?
discriminators: The sidebar selection and chat area both change
Only a route or heading changes while another area remains unchanged
protocols.stop_condition: Stop if a real chat or identifying conversation title becomes visible

protocols.question: When does the draft cease to be an editable draft and become a visible submitted item?
discriminators: A visible submitted item appears before response progress
The draft remains pending until some later visible transition
protocols.stop_condition: Stop before entering any personal message or attachment

protocols.question: What visible sequence separates partial output, explicit stop, and natural completion?
discriminators: Partial content becomes visible and then a terminal completion state appears
The control remains active or stopping produces another terminal state
protocols.stop_condition: Stop if the session is not disposable or the response includes identifying content

protocols.question: What visible ancestry or alternative-navigation controls change after an earlier message is edited or regenerated?
discriminators: An alternative remains selectable in the same visible conversation
The earlier reply disappears from the visible navigation without an accessible alternative
protocols.stop_condition: Never derive server message identities from visual behavior alone

protocols.question: What remains visible in the original versus the newly branched fictional conversation?
discriminators: A distinct conversation navigation entry appears and the original remains available
A separate chat is visible but the preserved prefix or navigational relationship differs
protocols.stop_condition: Do not record route literals, conversation identifiers or copied messages

protocols.question: Which coarse UI states survive a reload or a separate tab?
discriminators: Conversation selection survives while draft state does not
Selection, draft and visible response states persist in a different combination
protocols.stop_condition: Do not read or export storage values

protocols.question: What observable recovery path follows a naturally occurring failure of a fictional response?
discriminators: A retry control becomes available and leads to new generation
The UI instead exposes a different recovery affordance or no retry
protocols.stop_condition: Do not deliberately induce failures on the live service

protocols.question: How do abstract transport lifecycle categories line up with visible UI transitions?
discriminators: The UI begins receiving before a terminal transport signal
The UI state changes in a different relative order than the transport categories
protocols.stop_condition: Do not store requests, endpoints, headers, payloads, tokens, or identifiers
